criteria.description: Each touched web Nostr helper module is at or below 200 lines.
criteria.verification: wc -l over nip07*, nip46*, encrypted-controlplane*, and nostr-hex.js showed all files <=200 lines.

criteria.description: Existing public imports for NIP-07, NIP-46, and encrypted control-plane remain compatible.
criteria.verification: Original files remain as compatibility facades exporting the same public functions/constants/classes used by existing tests and callers.

criteria.description: NIP-07 and NIP-46 signing plus NIP-44 encryption/decryption semantics are preserved.
criteria.verification: Targeted unit tests for NIP-07 and NIP-46 pass, including pubkey validation, signer methods, capabilities, NIP-44 blockers, encryption/decryption calls, retry, and queue behavior.

criteria.description: Encrypted ContextVM control-plane publish/result behavior remains event-driven and verifies relay OK outcomes.
criteria.verification: Encrypted control-plane unit tests pass for request event construction, accepted OK enforcement, scoped result subscriptions, EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH handling, dedupe, decrypt/correlation errors, cleanup, and cancellation.

criteria.description: Tests are deterministic for the touched NIP-07 async behavior.
criteria.verification: NIP-07 availability timeout, late injection, transient retry, and serialization tests no longer depend on wall-clock sleeps.
